title: alisma graminifolium f. terrestre
intro: Alisma graminifolium f. terrestre, commonly known as water plantain, is a plant-based medicinal herb used in traditional Chinese medicine. It has been reported to possess various health benefits, including diuretic and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in the treatment of edema, hypertension, and other related conditions. The therapeutic actions of water plantain are attributed to its ability to regulate water metabolism, lower blood pressure, and alleviate pain and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of water plantain include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
